name: NAIRE
purpose: Compose the human-side operating environment for progression, value, opportunities, relationships, capabilities and economic participation.
authority_model: Human authority and consent remain explicit; NAIRE does not create authority through intelligence, matching or Pulse.
data_model: Human canonical identity, capabilities, relationships, needs, offers, opportunities, activity and value observations with provenance.
evidence_model: Claims about capability, status or outcomes remain linked to supporting evidence and source provenance.
economic_model: Composes Value, Market, Exchange and I/O capabilities without redefining their canonical semantics.
pulse_model: Uses outcome/value signals for learning and feedback; Pulse is neither authority nor underlying Value.
continuity_model: Personal state, obligations, relationships, evidence and active commitments persist across product/provider changes.
exit_handoff: Transfer canonical human state, active work, opportunities, obligations, authority and evidence to the receiving HAPI or product capability.
